definitions.gloss: straightforward, direct, concise, to the point
definitions.explanation: Describes expressing something clearly and directly without beating around the bush. Used for speech, writing, and descriptions that get straight to the essential point.

examples.japanese: {端的|たんてき}に{言|い}えば{失敗|しっぱい}だ。
examples.english: To put it bluntly, it was a failure.

examples.japanese: {端的|たんてき}に{事実|じじつ}を{述|の}べてください。
この{一言|ひとこと}が、{問題|もんだい}の{本質|ほんしつ}を{端的|たんてき}に{表|あらわ}している。
examples.english: This single remark concisely captures the essence of the problem.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as a na-adjective ({端的|たんてき}な) and is very commonly used as an adverb with に: {端的|たんてき}に{言|い}う (to say directly). This is a somewhat formal word used when someone wants to cut through complexity and state things plainly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {端的|たんてき}に{言|い}う: to put it simply/directly
- {端的|たんてき}に{言|い}えば: to put it bluntly
- {端的|たんてき}に{表|あらわ}す: to express concisely
- {端的|たんてき}な{表現|ひょうげん}: a concise expression
- {端的|たんてき}に{示|しめ}す: to show directly
